mcgyvr.task: Add a docstring to the method DoorLinks.start in src/mcgyvr/fleet/linkread.py (the method that spawns `python -m mcgyvr.serving.run link --host H ...` and returns a Pending). One short paragraph in the file's existing voice: what it starts, what it returns, and that stdin is closed. Change nothing else in the file.
mcgyvr.interface:
class DoorLinks:
    def start(self, host: str, args: Sequence[str]) -> Pending
demonstration: python -B -c "import ast,sys; t=ast.parse(open('src/mcgyvr/fleet/linkread.py').read()); c=[n for n in ast.walk(t) if isinstance(n,ast.ClassDef) and n.name=='DoorLinks'][0]; f=[n for n in c.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='start'][0]; sys.exit(0 if ast.get_docstring(f) else 1)"
